question: With normal tail KV fixed, does question-stage Attention Query replacement alter the effect of restoring pre-tail recurrent matrices on fresh streams?
cohort_scope: All8new streams, both tail lengths8/64 and related/unrelated episodes, all3roles and2styles; retain every pre-tail and post-tail baseline failure. No output-based case selection.

seed_rule.rule: First8integers at or above start absent from the frozen inventory; only exact prior-input/identity nonoverlap and tokenizer boundary feasibility checked before any model inference.

task_generator.semantics: Unchanged executable SET state, current/initial/protected questions;9prefix SET records,8accounts,8/64tail records. Only seeds change.

cache_origins.N: Normally encoded prefix followed by an entirely normal tail.
cache_origins.H: Independent fork of N after tail; replace only all18recurrent matrices with the same model/stream normal pre-tail matrices. Preserve normal convolution, all KV and complete after-tail bookkeeping. No gate suppression during tail.

before_conditions: Natural normally encoded prefix under both readers; all48before questions, no crossover or Query replacement.
condition_order: First letter recipient recurrent-cache origin, second letter question Query donor origin. NN/HH are unpatched baselines; NH/HN are cross-source Query interventions. Additional actual same-source replacements replay NN/HH exactly as operational controls.
query_capture: Only known question suffix at the fixed after-tail cache boundary. Capture actual post-q_norm/post-RoPE Query tensor passed to the native eager Attention dot product in each of6Attention layers. Capture interface accepts cache, known text/tokens and reader context, never answer, role, support-label lookup or generated tokens. No gold scoring or generation in capture.
reader_specific_donors: Capture N/H Query tensors separately for full/oracle reading. A full-reader intervention can only use a full-reader donor; no oracle-derived activation enters any full-reader branch. Oracle support remains privileged and separately labelled.
query_replacement: Replace actual Query arguments in all6Attention eager calls during the one cached question-suffix forward only, preserving shape,dtype,device,position and native affine arithmetic. Keep recipient K,V,mask,scaling,dropout,output gate,residual and MLP inputs untouched by the wrapper. Later autoregressive/gold continuation forwards run normally, without further Query replacement.
causal_boundary: Original TextRuntime.probe first forwards only the question suffix, then performs gold-only serial scoring and unconstrained greedy continuation. Query captures must precede and be independent of all answer computation. Reject extra/missing question calls, any prefill capture, unequal prompt IDs or attempts to patch answer/decode rows.

operational_controls.cache_controls: Complete actual tensor inventory/all attributes/layouts; both N/H source caches and donor Query storage guarded after every capture, replay and readout. All sources isolated, restored R exactly equals normal prefix; recipient convolution and all KV exactly normal;12prefix KV slices preserved.
operational_controls.query_controls: Record all9216actual donor tensor byte fingerprints/layouts/finite values. Guard every donor against mutation. All6actual layers exactly1captured/replaced question call; preserve every non-Query argument across wrapper invocation. Same-source actual replacement must replay all1536unpatched five-field outcomes exactly, not bypass replacement.
operational_controls.attention_controls: Observe all6actual eager layers in each readout/capture. Zero prefill calls; oracle blocked probability/mass0; full positive; all wrapper/hook/kernel identities restored.
operational_controls.numerical_and_parameter_controls: Reuse all10native-precision kernel checks and original immutable addendum, preserving ideal-FP32 failure. Freeze exact native and fixed adapter bytes and all existing arithmetic; same96legacy controls as predecessor. No new accuracy tolerance.

analysis.complete_reporting: All3264primary rows; distinguish1536unpatched after baselines,1536cross-source interventions,192pre-tail baselines and1536same-source operational replays. All16after and4before cells, roles/styles/streams, related/unrelated lengths and fixed-prefix/new-tail evidence, Joint3/6 and every paired gain/loss.
analysis.fixed_contrasts: HNvsHH: normal Query into restored-state recipient. NHvsNN: restored-state Query into normal recipient. HHvsNN: unpatched state effect. Query-source×recipient-state finite differences on gold NLL for each fixed question/reader. Report both models, both readers, all strata; retain all baseline failures.
analysis.limits: Fresh-data replication of this defined intervention, not architecture confirmation. Cross-source Query/hidden states may be off distribution. All6Query donors contain upstream computations, not an isolated raw GDN representation. A rescue does not uniquely establish semantic address construction; a failure does not prove Query irrelevant. Oracle donors never enter full reader. No percent-mediated/significance/novelty claim or new architecture success/scaleup gate.
